Item Title:
Consider approving ES2 for the upgrade of HVAC controls at City Hall, costing $197,200. Thus,
ensuring consistency with the systems already in place across other City buildings. Sole source
number, SS25-18 identifies ES2 as a sole-source provider, approved by the City of Lawton
Finance Department.
Initiator: Judy Franco, IT Director
Information Source: Judy Franco, IT Director
Background:
City Hall currently operates with two separate HVAC control systems—Johnson Controls and
ES2. Managing and fixing problems is difficult with this system because staff have to use two
separate platforms. Switching to the ES2 system will make things run smoother, help with
system checks, and give a clearer picture of how the HVAC is working. This enhancement will
equip our Building Maintenance team to respond to issues and ensure a comfortable environment
for both employees and the public accessing City Hall.
Correlation to the True North Statement:
Retrofitting the current HVAC controls with ES2 reinforces our commitment to delivering
services efficiently and addressing all matters with a sense of urgency.
Exhibit:
Quote; authorized sole source memo
Key Issues:
Funding Source:
8003001-51025 : Available - $200,000; Cost - $192,700
Recommended Action:
Approve ES2 to retrofit City Hall HVAC controls, to allow all City buildings to be on the same
platform.
ATTACHMENTS:
1. City of Lawton City Hall Retrofit BAS Quote Rev 2
2. SS25-18 ES2-Signed
